summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Teekay Tankers Ltd. reporting its second quarter 2026 earnings. The filing discloses GAAP net income of $225.9M ($6.49/share) and adjusted net income of $193.6M ($5.56/share). It notes fleet renewal transactions: acquisition of two Suezmax newbuilding contracts for $190M total and sale of two vessels for $138M total proceeds. The company declared a $0.25/share cash dividend. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report, not triggering a special situation category, as it merely summarizes operational and financial results with no transformative corporate event.
